diagnosis.reason: The bootstrap-valid C14 evidence comparator mechanically recomputed all 28 final-pair keys under the declared contract and found only 10 valid and 18 invalid. Evidence fail-closed correctly. The novelty config required key computation but did not explicitly forbid inherited/cached keys after the final current-wave source tuple changed and did not require a 100% pre-publication key self-audit.
diagnosis.scope: identity layer only; no claim that novelty/relevance semantic judgments are wrong

changes: Define exact UTF-8 compact JSON serialization with ensure_ascii=false for canonical key hashing.
Require final current-wave tuple assembly before key recomputation.
Forbid key/manifest/digest inheritance or caching across waves/source-blob changes even when semantic judgments are reused.
Require a 100% producer-side recomputation self-audit before final pointer/receipt publication; compute candidate-set digest only after that audit.
On mismatch, publish diagnostic/provenance-only output and do not advance downstream-consumable final pointers.
Require identity-normalization reissues to rebuild all tuples, keys and digest under schema2 while preserving semantic judgments and predecessor provenance.

before_after_rationale.before: Config8 prevented fuzzy joins and defined canonical keys, but a producer could still reuse semantic assessments and accidentally carry predecessor canonical keys into a current-wave manifest without a mandatory 100% self-check.
before_after_rationale.after: Config9 separates reusable semantics from non-reusable identity material: every current-wave tuple produces a freshly recomputed key, the full manifest is mechanically self-audited at 100%, and the digest is derived only after key validation.

rollback.condition: If schema2 serialization cannot be reproduced by the producer transport or causes valid current-wave manifests to fail despite recomputation from identical displayed tuple values, restore downstream control15/config8 and retain the C14 diagnostic as provenance; do not relax integrator/evidence mechanical membership rules.
